title: ygg.decisions/v1
description: What a person gives at a gate: decisions under ids they choose, answers to the design's open questions, and for a rejection a reason. An operator's file, not an agent's output, so it has no blocked. It must say something: decisions, answers or reason (checked in code). The reason is required for a rejection only (checked by Odin).

decisions.description: Owner decisions. The ids are the operator's and stable across runs.

answers.description: Answers to this run's open questions, by question id.

id.description: The operator's id for the decision; unique in the file.

text.description: The decision, one line or many.

answer.description: The answer to one open question.

question.description: The id of an open question of this run's design.

text.description: The answer, one line or many.
